en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional, no author known. Several lines are in a dialect with unusual forms (ју, треста, терезија); lines 4, 7 and 9 are my reading and partly guessed, in particular 'терезија' as a balance or measuring scale and 'да не ѕида' as 'so he builds'.

lines.cyr: Ој, ју весине море, не се догледоваш
lines.lat: Oj, ju vesine more, ne se dogledovaš
lines.en: Oh, in your height, hey, you cannot be seen to the end

lines.cyr: ју ширине море, не се изидоваш.
lines.lat: ju širine more, ne se izidovaš.
lines.en: in your breadth, hey, you cannot be built round.

lines.cyr: Ој, у тебе се, море, до треста мајстора,
lines.lat: Oj, u tebe se, more, do tresta majstora,
lines.en: Oh, on you there are, hey, three hundred masters,

lines.cyr: ју тебе се, море, до триста мајстора.
lines.lat: ju tebe se, more, do trista majstora.
lines.en: on you there are, hey, three hundred masters.

lines.cyr: Ој, меџо њима, море, мајстор Димитрија
lines.lat: Oj, medžo njima, more, majstor Dimitrija
lines.en: Oh, among them, hey, master Dimitrija
in his hands he holds a scale.

lines.cyr: Ој, да не ѕида море, цркве, манастире, ој
lines.lat: Oj, da ne dzida more, crkve, manastire, oj
lines.en: Oh, so that he does not build, hey, churches, monasteries, oh

lines.cyr: и у цркве, море, до триста попове.
lines.lat: i u crkve, more, do trista popove.
lines.en: and in the churches, hey, three hundred priests.
